artworks.title: Shed (Le hangar)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The etching depicts a low angle view looking up from a path. Tall trees with dense foliage obscure the horizon. There is a fence and a structure among the trees. The brushstrokes are expressive and loose, with fine lines for detail. The color palette is monochromatic, with contrast between dark and light areas. The sky is lighter in the background, accentuating the silhouette of the trees and house.

artworks.title: Sir E.J. Poynter, P.R.A.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, depicting his upper body from the chest up. He is positioned in three-quarters view, slightly turned to the right, facing towards the viewer with his gaze directed at them. The man's facial features include a prominent full beard and mustache, with short, neatly combed hair. He has a serious expression with deeply set eyes. The man is wearing what appears to be a light-colored coat or outer garment, which contrasts against the finely detailed lines that fill the background of the image. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person in the portrait. The background consists of evenly spaced horizontal lines, providing a textured surface that contrasts with the figure’s smooth attire. The artist's signature, "A. Legros," is visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Refectory (Le refectoire)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals seated around a table. The individuals wear robes with hoods. They are engaged in various activities like eating, praying, or conversing. One man stands at the center interacting with the seated individuals. One man holds his hands together, another rests their head on their hand, and others are focused on their meals. One person is holding a book. The scene is in a dimly lit room with a cross and hanging lamp in the background. The table has plates and goblets on it, covered with a tablecloth. There are empty stools, a small jug on the floor, and a faint pattern on the walls, creating an intimate ambiance.

artworks.title: Bathers (Les baigneuses)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a forest. The black and white drawing depicts two unclothed individuals situated in a forest clearing. They are surrounded by tall trees with distinct, vertically aligned trunks and sparse foliage that forms a canopy overhead. The texture of the trees and the ground is created using dense lines and hatching. The figures are portrayed in a contemplative or relaxed pose, with one figure seated and the other standing, holding fabric draped around the lower body. The scene is intimate and serene, with a focus on the contrast between the natural setting and the human form.

artworks.title: English Beggars (Les mendiants anglais)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures seated on the ground near a wooden structure under a cloudy sky. The scene is depicted with intricate linework and shading, creating a somber atmosphere. The setting includes a rustic backdrop with wooden scaffolding and a solid stone wall. In the foreground, various objects can be seen. Light and shadow are used to enhance the dramatic and contemplative nature of the drawing.

artworks.title: Farm with Large Tree (La ferme au grand arbre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with a large tree on the right side, extending upward and out of the frame. In the background, there is a body of water reflecting the scene, with grasses and rocks in the foreground. The horizon is below the middle, featuring a silhouette of a house with a steeply pitched roof and a chimney, along with a cart or wagon on a hill. The sky has clouds and the brushstrokes are detailed, with cross-hatching for contrast. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of dark brown and sepia, consistent with an etching technique.

artworks.title: Old Woman Seated (La vieille femme assise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a seated elderly person with their upper body and part of their lower body visible. The individual is sitting with arms in front, head slightly bent forward. The person's detailed facial features are emphasized with shadows on the cheeks, nose, and eyes. The eyes are obscured by heavy shading. The person wears an old-fashioned cap with curly hair visible and a long, dark robe or cloak reaching down to their feet. The artwork is created with strong lines and cross-hatching for texture. The background consists of a dense pattern of lines, highlighting the figure. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Broken Cart (La charrette brisee)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a person crouching beside an overturned cart with a single wheel. The person's head is slightly bowed, facing the ground, and their face is partially visible in a side view. They are wearing a headscarf or bonnet and a long dress or coat. The person appears to be handling a bundle or sack. The background is sketched with fine lines, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Milkmaid of Boulogne, 1st plate (Laitiere a Boulogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is an image of a donkey carrying burdens. The drawing shows a donkey with several large bundles on its back. Next to the donkey, a figure appears to be guiding it forward with a stick. The scene is depicted with delicate lines and minimal shading, creating a sense of simplicity and lightness. The background features indications of grass and a fence line, giving the scene an open and airy feel. The style of the drawing is characteristic of an etching, emphasizing lines and textures.

artworks.title: Milkmaid of Boulogne, 1st plate (Laitiere a Boulogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a donkey, moving from left to right. The horizon line is visible at the lower third of the image, where brush and grass meet the sky. The etching technique showcases fine lines with varied densities for shadows and light. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones. There are soft contours of bushes or low trees in the background.

artworks.title: Farm on a Hillside in Sunlight (La ferme du coteau; Effet de soleil sur le coteau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a forest and hills in the background. Tall trees frame the setting, leading the eye to a small house among the foliage. The composition features intricate cross-hatched brushstrokes creating texture and depth. The color palette is primarily warm sepia tones. The artwork is signed in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Farm on a Hillside in Sunlight (La ferme du coteau; Effet de soleil sur le coteau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a house surrounded by trees. The perspective is slightly elevated, providing a view of the house amidst foliage. The horizon is obstructed by trees arching over the scene. The artwork uses cross-hatching brushstrokes to depict depth and texture. It is a monochrome etching using shades of black and gray. Large trees frame the sides of the image, with houses and vegetation in the background. The overall lighting suggests clearing skies above the trees.

artworks.title: Day-dream (Le reveur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated on the ground in a thoughtful pose. He is resting his head on one hand while the other hand holds a long stick. The man has distinct facial features, including a beard and bald head. He is dressed in a long cloak and appears to be wearing a tunic or shirt underneath. Next to him on the ground is a round hat. The background is minimally detailed, with subtle lines suggesting foliage or landscape on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Woman Reading: Lesson under the Trees (La liseuse: La lecture sous les arbres)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with undulating hills and distant mountains meeting the sky. The detailed etching lines create a textured surface showing the landscape, foliage, and a figure seated beneath tall trees. The scene conveys a tranquil setting with a path framed by vegetation. The color palette consists of muted sepia tones.

artworks.title: Traveler Resting (Repos du voyageur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a seated position. There is a figure reclining on the ground near a tree, framed by the tree foliage. In the background, there are hills, a mountain, and a clear sky. The artist uses cross-hatch brushstrokes for texture and depth in the foreground, and lighter lines for the sky and distant elements. The color palette is monochrome, with various shades of sepia or brown.

artworks.title: Banks of the Liane (Les bords de la Liane)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape with an elevated perspective. The horizon is low, marked by bushes and distant land. Trees frame the scene, with detailed branches and trunks. A figure is fishing by a calm stream in the foreground. The color palette is sepia and black, highlighting textures and creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Job, 2nd plate
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching? on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting down, leaning forward with legs slightly bent. The person has thinning, medium-length hair and a long beard covering their face, which is turned slightly downward. They wear a simple garment, possibly a robe, that covers the upper body but leaves the legs bare. The background shows a rocky or earthen surface, suggesting the person is seated against a stone or in a natural setting. There is no visible jewelry, and the person does not hold anything in their hands. The scene is rendered in a monochrome style, focusing on texture and line work.

artworks.title: Edge of a Brook (Bord de ruisseau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a tree trunk leaning diagonally. The scene lacks a clear horizon and focuses on detailed tree features and foliage. The etching style employs fine lines to depict bark and leaves. Sepia tones dominate the color palette, creating a warm, monochromatic look. Varied line weights add depth and texture, showcasing the natural intricacy of the wooded setting.

artworks.title: Edge of a Brook (Bord de ruisseau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a densely forested area, with thick tree trunks and detailed foliage. The perspective is angled upwards towards the towering trees and branches that disappear out of the frame. The artwork features dynamic strokes creating texture and shadow to emphasize the natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and grey for contrast and highlighting the linework. Dark shadows and lighter spaces capture the interplay of light filtering through the leaves, creating a moody representation of a forest.

artworks.title: Thatched Cottage (Chaumiere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a small cabin and a barren tree close to us, slightly off-center to the left. The horizon is high, subtly indicated by the roofline of the cabin and the flat expanse extending to a wall that blends into the ground. The cabin with a thatched roof stands out in the monochromatic artwork, with detailed etching lines providing texture and depth to the structure. In the distance, behind the cabin, the land continues into an inclining landscape. The style of the artwork is an etching, featuring fine lines for texture, and hatching and cross-hatching techniques for dimensionality and shading. The color palette is limited to black and white, creating a stark contrast to highlight the simplicity and serenity of the rural setting.

artworks.title: Birch Trees: Water's Edge Seen in Morning Light (Les Bouleaux: Bord de l'eau, effet du matin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a serene landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint overlooking a riverbank. The horizon is high, formed by tall, slender trees. The brushstrokes are delicate with fine lines and hatching techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying tones of black and grey. A figure is near the riverbank and the river reflects the sparse foliage and trees.

artworks.title: Castle in Spain (Chateau en Espagne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with various trees, bushes, and a sloping terrain depicted through line work. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a view of the scene with a hill in the distance. The artwork uses detailed linear strokes to create texture and depth, especially in the foliage. The artist applied cross-hatching for shadow and dimension. The color scheme is predominantly black and white, creating a serene atmosphere. The foreground has sparse hatching indicating grass, leading towards denser vegetation.

artworks.title: Abandoned Village (Le village abondonne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image showcases a pastoral landscape with a river or stream in the foreground. The vista extends into the distance with a horizon lined by foliage and old structures. The etching technique uses fine lines to depict textures and depth, detailing the overgrown banks and rooftops. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow. The water shows gentle ripples reflecting the scene, with aged buildings partially concealed by vegetation. The scene transitions to a light sky in the distance, emphasizing perspective.

artworks.title: Along the River (Sur la riviere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a point of view at eye level, showing a close-up of a dense cluster of trees or foliage. The horizon is obscured by the trees which fill the composition. The etching technique uses fine lines to represent the texture of the leaves and branches. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray on a beige paper background highlighting the linear detailing. The artist's signature "A. Legros" is seen in the lower right corner.
